verdict.rationale: Superpowers documents in-agent marketplace installation for Claude Code (`/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace` then `/plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace`). Devin CLI has a true one-liner (`devin plugins install obra/superpowers`) with skills that auto-trigger at session start, and Antigravity's session-start hook makes it active from the first message. Skills then trigger automatically with no further setup. Missing for 10: Claude Code takes two commands rather than one; install differs per harness, with Hermes needing a git clone and Codex/OpenCode using an unusual agent-driven, curl|bash-like flow; no independent hands-on confirmation that skills activate in the next session.
